name: Admissions Assistant Landing
summary: Warm olive marketing landing for an application assistant: sticky header with keyboard dropdown menus and a mobile menu dialog, serif hero with a code-built dashboard in a noise-gradient frame, scrolling wordmark marquee, six feature cards with live mock UIs (timeline, scholarships, essay review, sample essay, rewrite, final read ring), FAQ accordion, centred CTA and a six-column footer.
useWhen: Starting a calm, editorial landing page for an education or writing product
Needing feature cards that show small product UIs instead of screenshots
avoidWhen: A motion-heavy or dark-first launch page
A dashboard or app shell rather than a marketing page
source: kolly.ai (layout, spacing, type and motion reference); copy, brand, school logos and imagery replaced with neutral placeholders
